scope: vendor DeepSeek V4 MXFP4 down expert GPU correctness scaffold

build_requirement.reason: Without this option moe_stream_batch.cu exports the stub under #ifndef GGML_CUDA_MOE_STREAM_BATCH and all down batch calls return false.

source_changes: Extend ggml_cuda_moe_stream_batch ABI to pass CPU fallback Q8_0 activation rows (src1_q8_0, row_size, ne1).
Add default-off GGML_MOE_STREAM_DOWN_Q80_COMPAT_BATCH path for MXFP4 down tensors.
Add GGML_MOE_STREAM_DOWN_Q80_CPU_ORDER=1 kernel mode that reproduces the x86 AVX2/VNNI lane accumulation order and reaches op-level max_abs=0 against CPU fallback.
Add target-only guard so GGML_MOE_STREAM_DOWN_Q80_COMPAT_TENSOR can isolate one down tensor while non-target MXFP4 down falls back to CPU.
Add batch success CPU-compare hook gated by GGML_MOE_STREAM_COMPARE_CPU_OUT.

strict_memory.result: all correctness probes completed without cgroup kill or OOM

op_level_compare.note: Previous scalar-order GPU Q80 had ~1e-7 local error and flipped top1; CPU-order mode removed the local error.

decision.reason_not_sota: Full-down CPU-order Q80 GPU path is token-stable but slower than CPU fallback in the fixed-text probe.
decision.next_step: Use this correctness-stable down GPU path as the reference while optimizing kernel/dataflow performance; do not promote to generalized token-rate SOTA until strict cold generalized prompts improve over the no-prompt-specific baseline.
